SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_SPEAR.title: Spear
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_TREASURESPE: When played, put a random [gold]Spear[/gold] with the same upgrade level into your hand. It gains [gold]Cat's Vault[/gold], [gold]Exhaust[/gold], and [gold]Retain[/gold].
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_CORRUPT.des:
Hunter only:
When you play a [gold]Corrupted[/gold] card, gain 1 [gold]Corruption Value[/gold]. When [gold]Corruption Value[/gold] reaches 5, gain 10 [gold]Fungal Plating[/gold] and [gold]Enter Fungalization[/gold].
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_HUNTSIGN.de: When taking damage from a [gold]Slugcat[/gold], consume 1 Prey Mark and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Fullness[/gold].
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_FOOD.descri: In combat, you can use [gold]Fullness[/gold] to [gold]Hibernate[/gold] and increase your [gold]Karma[/gold].
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_FOOD.title: Fullness
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_WORKLEVEL.d:
When you take [red]fatal damage[/red], if your [gold]Karma[/gold] is not [blue]1[/blue], lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Karma[/gold], [gold]Rebirth[/gold] and restore all HP.
You cannot increase your Max HP through normal means.
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_LIGHTNING.d: Deal 8 damage to all targets of this card. If any target damaged has [gold]Water Erosion[/gold], deal 8 damage to all targets with [gold]Water Erosion[/gold] again.
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_IMMUNITY.de: This card cannot be Corrupted. When drawn, gain 1 Energy; if you are Fungalized, lose 1 Energy instead.
When you lose [gold]Karma[/gold], trigger [gold]Karmic Retribution[/gold] effects.
Return the card to your hand.
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_SIMULATED.d:
When you play a card, if this card is in your hand, transform it into the card you just played.
Whether the transformed card Exhausts depends on whether the original card Exhausts.
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_LAST.descri:
Multiplayer only.
[gold]Hunter Long Legs[/gold] plays cards as follows: from left to right, but only Attack cards, and at most 5 cards per turn.
[gold]Hunter Long Legs[/gold] is immune to all damage and dies after all other players have died.
SLUGCAT_THE_SPIRE_II_KEYWORD_LAST.title: Hunter Long Legs
